newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets one-week rev repo at max 39 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets one-week rev repo at max 39 pct.

text.p: The Czech central bank (CNB) on Monday set a reverse repo tender to drain funds from the market with a maximum rate of 39 percent, unchanged from a similar operation on Friday.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from participants of a minimum 100 million crowns until 9.45 a.m. (0745 GMT) in the tender.
The CNB has been holding several reverse repo tenders daily to drain liquidity from the market to reduce the possibility of crown short-selling.
